title: TiO2/ZnO nanocomposites with a metal-free dye and a polymer gel electrolyte: optimizing photovoltaic efficiency and assessing stability via time series analysis
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,578-587
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00553H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Prakash S. Pawar, Pramod A. Koyale, Satyajeet S. Patil, Swapnil R. Patil, Jinho Bae, Nilesh R. Chodankar, Yash G. Kapdi, Saurabh S. Soni, Pramod S. Patil, Sagar D. Delekar
The study highlights a 1.8-fold efficiency improvement in metal-free SK3 dye-sensitized solar cells using a TiO2/ZnO nanocomposite and polymer gel electrolyte, attributing to enhanced charge transport, reduced resistance, and improved surface area.
